prompt:
PLAN 10 | THE SHARED POSSESSION | 15 SECONDS

Create a horizontal 16:9 cinematic sequence for Seedance 2.5.
Three shots lasting three, eight and four seconds.

CHARACTER REFERENCES:
Shahrnaz = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
Arnavaz = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
Zahhak and his living shoulder serpents = {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}

ANIMAL REFERENCE:
Cat = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}

PROP REFERENCE:
Serpent-headed staff = {{PROP_STAFF}}

REFERENCE INTERPRETATION:
Use the images for character identity, masks, costumes, anatomy and prop design. Relight every referenced subject according to the lighting described below.

LOCATION AND VISIBLE ENVIRONMENT:
Interior of Zahhak’s chamber, concealed by complete surrounding darkness.
The visible image consists exclusively of the three characters, the living serpents, the held cat and the staff against black.

LIGHTING:
Begin with the lighting already established.

One hard overhead spotlight shines vertically onto the tightly grouped characters. Its coverage includes both sisters and Zahhak standing directly before them.

Concentrated cold-neutral light catches the crowns of their heads, upper mask planes, shoulders, forearms, hands, serpent scales and the cat’s fur.

Deep shadows fall beneath brows, chins and arms. Lower clothing progressively disappears into black.

Beyond the illuminated bodies, the image is solid black. Architecture and floor remain unexposed. Frame above floor level.

Use minimal reflected light, hard contrast and fixed exposure. The background stays equally black in every camera angle. The spotlight remains steady.

START STATE:
Shahrnaz stands WEST, Arnavaz EAST, seventy centimeters apart, facing NORTH.
Shahrnaz securely holds the cat against her chest.
Arnavaz’s left shoulder is lowered; retain the established costume dust.

Zahhak stands NORTH of their midpoint, facing SOUTH toward both women. He holds the staff in his RIGHT hand.

SHOT 24A | 00:00–00:03 | BETWEEN THEM

35mm waist-up view from SOUTH, looking NORTH.

Shahrnaz’s BACK is foreground-left.
Arnavaz’s BACK is foreground-right.
Zahhak’s FRONT faces them through the central gap.

Zahhak raises the staff head between their sightlines, at mask-eye height, forty centimeters in front of their faces.

A shoulder serpent flexes slowly while another slides over his clothing.

The handheld camera edges closer, keeping the three bodies tightly grouped against black.

SHOT 24B | 00:03–00:11 | TRANSFER AND TEST

50mm medium-close two-shot from NORTH, beside Zahhak, looking SOUTH.

Arnavaz’s FRONT appears screen-left.
Shahrnaz’s FRONT appears screen-right with the cat.
The edge of Zahhak’s BACK occupies the extreme left foreground.
The staff head remains visible centrally between both masks.

00:03–00:06:
Zahhak holds the staff centered with a minute vibration from his hand.

Both women catch their breath. Their fingers tremble and a brief shudder passes through both sets of shoulders.

Shahrnaz maintains firm support beneath the cat while the fingertips resting on its fur tremble.

Their heads remain directed toward the stationary staff.

00:06–00:07:
The trembling stops. Both exhale, loosen their fingers and become still.
Hold one clear beat.

00:07–00:11:
Zahhak moves the staff head thirty centimeters screen-left.
Both heads turn screen-left together, torsos stationary.

He reverses screen-right.
Both heads follow immediately.

He returns the staff to center.
Both heads return and stop with it.

Keep the staff and both masks visible throughout this uninterrupted take. The camera’s initial unease settles as the bodies become obedient.

SHOT 24C | 00:11–00:15 | CONTROL

50mm from SOUTH, looking NORTH.

The sisters’ BACKS frame Zahhak’s FRONT:
Shahrnaz left, Arnavaz right.

Push slowly toward Zahhak as he lowers the staff.
Both sisters remain still.

His living serpents continue small independent head turns and muscular movement. Their highlights emerge from and disappear into the black around his shoulders.

END STATE:
Both women are possessed.
Shahrnaz holds the cat.
Arnavaz’s hands are empty.
Zahhak holds the staff in his right hand.

SOUND:
Caught breaths, trembling fabric, two slow exhalations and scales moving against clothing.

NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.

Established requirements for this subject:
- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.

<<<image_1>>> is Zahhak (CHR-001 V08); match it wherever Zahhak appears.
<<<image_2>>> is Arnavaz (CHR-004 V01); match it wherever Arnavaz appears.
<<<image_3>>> is Shahrnaz (CHR-005 V01); match it wherever Shahrnaz appears.
<<<image_4>>> is Cat Persian Longhair (CRT-004 V01); match it wherever Cat Persian Longhair appears.
<<<image_5>>> is Dagger Horse Head (PRP-019 V02); match it wherever Dagger Horse Head appears.
<<<image_6>>> is Staff - Bronze Cobra (PRP-001 V01); match it wherever Staff - Bronze Cobra appears.
